title: Normalized natural transformation for sectionwise scalar extension
statement: For every scheme T and fixed model m : SectionModel a T, there is a natural transformation from the coefficient extension followed by the section equivalence to m.E after the source equivalence, satisfying the scalar-unit generator equation.

source.place: Stacks 03EK and 06YY, fixed-model scalar extension map

proof.text: Construct the sheafified change-of-rings map and verify its value on 1 tensor m; naturality follows from functoriality of tensoring and sheafification.

mathlib_searches.query: normalized natural transformation change of rings section generator
mathlib_searches.results: No existing declaration gives this fixed-model section map.

lean.statement:
theorem scalar_section_ordinary_normalized_map (T : Scheme.{u})
    (model : SectionModel a T) :
    ∃ ordinary : QuotientChange.extension a T ⋙
        (equivalence Λ' T).functor ⟶
      (equivalence Λ T).functor ⋙ model.E,
      ∀ (M : Modules Λ T) (W : T.ProEtᵒᵖ) (m : M.X.obj.obj W),
        (((ordinary.app M) ≫ eqToHom (model.obj_eq _)).val.app W)
            (((Mod.extendUnit (ProEtale.coefficientMap a T) M).hom.hom.app W) m) =
          (toSheafify (Scheme.ProEt.topology T)
            (SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsPresheaf (sectionQuotient a T)
              ((equivalence Λ T).functor.obj M)).presheaf).app W
                ((1 : (ring Λ' T).obj.obj W)
                  ⊗ₜ[(ring Λ T).obj.obj W,
                    ((sectionQuotient a T).hom.app W).hom] m)
